title: Components and slots
summary: A component is a reusable part of a page. Each directory under `client/components` defines one component. A page contains only component tags. Components can contain other components. A component that only shows the data it receives needs no service (a class that holds state and behavior). Slots (places where a parent component inserts its own content) are scoped. If components contain each other in a cycle, the build fails before publishing.
